name: Ortur H20 10W
tagline: Entry H20 chassis with integrated design and Ortur app workflow
tldr: Ortur H20 10W is the base diode tier on the H20 frame : faster traverse than LM3 with a more enclosed integration. Good for engraving and light cuts; step up to 20W or 40W for thicker wood.
mainObjective: High-quality hobby and light-business engraving with light, slow cutting

engraveExample.description: Filled photo or logo on birch plywood

cutExample.description: Simple square cut-out from 3 mm basswood

pros: Lowest H20 entry while keeping the integrated chassis and Ortur app workflow
Integrated H-series enclosure : beam containment and smoke control vs open-frame diodes
Best module in the line for photo fills, leather, and detail-heavy gifts
Swappable head : upgrade to 20W or 40W later on the same frame
410 × 275 mm work area with LightBurn and LaserGRBL support
cons: This module targets thin cuts (about 5 mm basswood class) : not thick production plywood
Higher modules in this line (20W or 40W) add cut speed and depth
Not the SKU for a shop cutting 5 mm+ stock all day
beginnerNotes: This profile is the 10W module on Ortur H20. Read the TL;DR and benchmarks above, then compare other modules via the chips before buying.
proTips: Run material test grids at engraving speeds first. Add air assist for light cuts on basswood. If cut jobs exceed ~30% of your week, compare the 20W or 40W module profiles before upgrading.

moduleSystem.headline: Swappable diode & IR modules
moduleSystem.description: H20 ships as a chassis with swappable 10W, 20W, or 40W diode modules and optional 2W IR heads for metal marking : verify which module is in the box.

editorialDepth.advantages: The H20 10W module keeps Ortur's integrated chassis while targeting engraving-first work : photo fills, leather gifts, and learning the platform at the lowest diode tier. Swap to 20W or 40W later on the same frame when cutting becomes regular revenue.
editorialDepth.limitations: Not the module for daily plywood production : thin basswood and light gifts only. Optional 2W IR is a separate head, not included. Compare 20W/40W profiles if cut time already dominates your quotes.
